card.title: Their Opinion Matters
card.instruction: Seek one person's approval while pretending their opinion is irrelevant. Adjust yourself whenever they respond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm painting Independence on the boat. You're welcome to watch; the name's settled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a lot of letters to paint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like the full name. I was offering to paint half.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Independence, then. I was only shortening it to save you work.
